slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第1章古圣传承
人族东荒，
万兽山脉某处，
一位白衣女子衣衫不整，
娇躯露出大片雪白晶莹的肌肤，
引人遐想联翩...
江尘目光不得已落在那处起伏动人的曲线上，
冰寒羞怒的如玉小脸上一抹诱人红霞渗透...
沧浪一声，
林曦月手中长剑离江尘的喉咙只有0.01公分，
美眸杀意凛然，
“说！
你和那个魔女是不是一伙的？”
江尘眼中茫然一闪而逝，
我竟然没死！
他本是仙界一方人皇，机缘下获得了古圣传承——吞天混沌经，八大异族皇者围杀夺宝，纵使他战力无双，力斩数名皇者，依旧力竭身亡，
没想到，自己没死，还穿越到异界的一个同名青年身上！
“什么魔女？我一介凡夫，怎么会认识魔女？”
林曦月点点真元凝于双眸，
果然，

这青年二十岁左右的年纪，
连凝气境也没有达到，
她眼中杀意不减，
但凡江尘暴露一丝破绽，她必将其挫骨扬灰！
“还不承认，你利用邪法掠夺了我一半功力！
若非与魔族妖女勾结，你怎会有此机会！”
江尘虽极力保持冷静，但额头还是冷汗涔涔，
“我只是路过此地，发生这种事也非我所愿，我江尘身为人族，宁死不做勾结异族坑害同胞的事情！
若你不信，杀了我便是！”
林曦月一愣，却是缓缓放下剑来，这男子正气凌然，或许自己真的错怪他了。
回忆起昨晚，
天鹅般的美丽脖颈飞上一抹嫣红，
她乃是太玄剑宗圣女林曦月，
奉师命擒拿魔族妖女，
在将要胜出之际，
却不慎中了妖女的魅魔淫毒，
本欲借助山涧水流逼出，
却正好遇到了江尘，
即便她都难以摆脱魔族淫毒，更何况这个连凝气期都不是的男子了。
林曦月性子清冷淡漠，也是被这种突发事件乱了方寸，
content_en:
Chapter 1 The inheritance of ancient saints
The human race is in the Eastern Wilderness,
Somewhere in the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains,
A woman in white clothes is disheveled,
The delicate body reveals a large area of snow-white crystal skin,
Captivating...
Jiang Chen's gaze had no choice but to fall on that undulating curve.
A touch of seductive red glow penetrated the cold, shy and angry face of Ruyu...
There was a cry from Canglang,
The long sword in Lin Xiyue's hand was only 0.01 centimeters away from Jiang Chen's throat.
Beautiful eyes with murderous intent,
"Say!
Are you and that witch together? "
Jiang Chen's eyes flashed with confusion,
I'm not dead!
He was originally a human emperor in the immortal world. By chance, he obtained the ancient saint's inheritance - the Heaven-Swallowing Chaos Sutra. Eight alien emperors surrounded him to capture the treasure. Even though he had unparalleled combat power and killed several emperors, he still died of exhaustion.
Unexpectedly, he did not die, but also traveled to a young man with the same name in another world!
"What witch? How can I, an ordinary person, know a witch?"
Lin Xiyue condensed a little bit of her true energy into her eyes,
Sure enough,
This young man is about twenty years old,
He didn't even reach the Qi Condensation state,
The murderous intent in her eyes never diminished;
Whenever Jiang Chen reveals any flaws, she will crush them to ashes!
"If you still don't admit it, you used evil methods to rob me of half of my skills!
If you hadn't colluded with the demon witch, how could you have had this opportunity! "
Although Jiang Chen tried his best to stay calm, cold sweat was still dripping from his forehead.
"I'm just passing by here, and I don't want this to happen. As a human race, I, Jiang Chen, would rather die than collude with foreign races to harm my compatriots!
If you don't believe it, just kill me! "
Lin Xiyue was stunned for a moment, but then she slowly put down her sword. This man was so upright, maybe she really blamed him wrongly.
Recalling last night,
A touch of bright red spreads on the beautiful swan-like neck,
She is Lin Xiyue, the saint of Taixuan Sword Sect.
He was ordered by his master to capture the demon witch.
On the verge of victory,
But he was accidentally poisoned by the witch's succubus.
I wanted to use the mountain water to force it out,
But he happened to meet Jiang Chen.
Even she can't get rid of the evil poison of the demon clan, let alone this man who is not even in the Qi Condensation stage.
Lin Xiyue, who has a cold and indifferent temperament, was also confused by this unexpected incident.
